headline: Crystal Palace appeal over Jean-Philippe Mateta red card rejected
description: Crystal Palace striker Jean-Philippe Mateta will serve a three-match ban after an appeal against his red card in Saturday's 2-0 Premier League defeat at Tottenham was rejected.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Arsenal want Atlético Madrid winger
description: Arsenal are keeping tabs on Atlético Madrid winger Álex Baena. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Romeo Lavia: Meeting Eden Hazard gave me extra motivation to succeed at Chelsea
description: Chelsea midfielder Romeo Lavia has said a meeting with fellow Belgian Eden Hazard has provided extra motivation as he looks to build on an encouraging start to the season.

headline: 'I'm not Mohamed Salah' - Bradley Barcola doesn't feel Liverpool pressure
description: Liverpool forward Bradley Barcola has insisted that he isn't feeling any pressure following his big-money move from Paris Saint-Germain and won't dwell on the impact of predecessor Mohamed Salah.

headline: Cole Palmer should have been sent off for Mateus Fernandes clash - KMI panel
description: Cole Palmer should have been sent off for Chelsea against Tottenham 10 minutes before he actually was, according to a panel which assesses the decisions of Premier League referees and VARs.

headline: Man United fans throwing tennis balls is part of soccer's rich history of supporter protests
description: After Manchester United's match was disrupted by tennis balls thrown onto the pitch, here are some of the various ways fans have made themselves heard.
